name: Hamlet
hook: One play, one castle, and a handful of characters Jeopardy asks for again and again.

facts.label: Elsinore
facts.statement: Hamlet is set at Elsinore, the Danish castle where Olivier, Gielgud and Plummer all played the prince.

facts.label: Claudius
facts.statement: Claudius murders Hamlet's father, marries Hamlet's mother Gertrude, and is played by Derek Jacobi in Branagh's film.

facts.label: Ophelia
facts.statement: Ophelia is Polonius's daughter and Laertes's sister; Hamlet spurns her, and she drowns.

facts.label: Polonius
facts.statement: Polonius, the pompous counselor, gives the advice "To thine own self be true" and is stabbed through the arras by Hamlet.
associations: To thine own self be true

facts.label: Yorick
facts.statement: Yorick is the dead court jester whose skull Hamlet holds — "a fellow of infinite jest, of most excellent fancy".

facts.label: Rosencrantz & Guildenstern
facts.statement: Rosencrantz and Guildenstern are Hamlet's schoolmates, sent to spy on him; Stoppard made them the leads of Rosencrantz & Guildenstern Are Dead.

facts.label: Laurence Olivier
facts.statement: Laurence Olivier won the Best Actor Oscar for the 1948 film of Hamlet, which also won Best Picture.
